phrase.zh: 把夏日的丰盛，留给冬天。

visual.zh: 近处木制圆筒由金属箍固定，开放断面露出密集青草与三叶草；右侧狭窄门口通向雪地，刻线区分木板、叶片与远处田野。
visual.en: Metal hoops hold a close wooden cylinder whose open cross-section reveals dense grass and clover; a narrow doorway at right opens onto snow, with engraved lines separating timber, leaves and distant fields.

background.zh:
维尔塔宁把生物化学研究用于农业和乳品生产，发展了保存新鲜饲料的方法。他因此获得1945年诺贝尔化学奖。画面把装满青草的储存容器与门外雪地并置，表达跨越季节的保存，是原创寓意，不是真实设备复原或饲料制作步骤。短句为原创。
1945年化学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：在农业和营养化学方面的研究与发明，尤其是饲料保存方法
background.en:
Virtanen applied biochemistry to agriculture and dairy production, developing a method for preserving fresh fodder. He received the 1945 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Packed grass beside a doorway onto snow expresses keeping resources across seasons. It is an original metaphor, not a reconstruction of equipment or a fodder-making procedure. The phrase is original.
1945 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his research and inventions in agricultural and nutrition chemistry, especially for his fodder preservation method
